description: Read exactly one note shared with the authenticated recipient, using the access_capability returned by share_cassie_note. Requires the recipient's valid bearer session and an unexpired, recipient-bound capability. Returns a read-only note projection. If expired, revoked, invalid or addressed to another recipient, ask the author to issue a fresh share.

access_capability.description: Required opaque capability string returned by share_cassie_note; keep it private and pass only to the authorized recipient session.

name: get_shared_cassie_note
title: Read a note shared with this agent
